rationale: Pre-registered follow-up for points that were high-noise or absent from the first R1.1 campaign. Seven complete blocks for large/intermediate points; the canonical producer-consumer is included to verify that its old InvalidDependencies result is still the current compiler fact and that A/B/C runtime remains a no-treatment comparison. No point is selected after seeing its new result.
